summary: Validated 3 fixes on /inicio.html (SingleFile): (1) VLibras floating icon hidden on mobile 390x844 (display:none/visibility:hidden confirmed via computed style on div[vw], #vlibras-access-wrapper, [vw-access-button]) and visible on desktop 1440 (icon rendered at right). (2) #blocoListaVagas table shrunk on mobile: td/th font-size=9px, table width=381px (100%), float:none. All three fixes are working as intended.
